rationale.oversight-theater: Defines Rubber-Stamp Risk: nominal review without authority, information, or influence.
rationale.automation-bias: Analyzes over-trust, reviewer fatigue, and declining challenge of model recommendations.
rationale.risk-routing: Operationalizes independent risk triggers, tier assignment, SLAs, and missed-escalation monitoring.
rationale.hitl-workflow: Specifies override rights, execution-boundary checkpoints, deferral, and escalation authority.
rationale.oversight-explanation: Provides decision-ready reasons, uncertainty, provenance, counterfactuals, and reviewer guidance.
rationale.org-governance: Defines roles, QA, audit logging, governance cadence, thresholds, and corrective actions.
rationale.regulatory-compliance: Maps intervention controls to ISO-style management and external audit expectations.
rationale.counterpoint: Opposes checkbox HITL that preserves accountability while withholding meaningful human agency.
rationale.metrics: Defines over-reliance metrics: override, escalation, latency, disagreement, harm, and drift.
